page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6r.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the arm64-based Ampere Altra processor. It features 32 dedicated physical vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.8 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This server does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate average performance across most compute and memory metrics, with notable variations in single-core versus multi-core workloads. The instance demonstrates a weak single-core Geekbench score of 1102.0 and weak single-threaded bzip3 decompression. However, it exhibits strong multi-threaded capabilities, as evidenced by a bzip3 multi-threaded decompression score of 221.31 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is measured at 2275.09 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 163.05 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

Given its dedicated arm64 architecture and balanced resource allocation, the ecs.g6r.8xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for multi-threaded workloads that do not require local SSD storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate LLM inference tasks, such as prompt processing and text generation with models up to 7B parameters.
